trans-unit.target: No se ha podido guardar la edición

trans-unit.source: There is no playable track to edit.

trans-unit.resname: Click the timeline to move the playhead and drag the handles to adjust. Space plays or pauses; the arrows move one second (five with Shift).
trans-unit.source: Click the timeline to move the playhead and drag the handles to adjust. Space plays or pauses; the arrows move one second (five with Shift).
trans-unit.target: Haz clic en la línea de tiempo para mover el cursor y arrastra las marcas para ajustarlas. La barra espaciadora reproduce o pausa; las flechas avanzan un segundo (cinco con Mayús).

trans-unit.resname: The breaks are skipped when the video is played.
trans-unit.source: The breaks are skipped when the video is played.
trans-unit.target: Las pausas se saltan al reproducir el vídeo.

trans-unit.resname: The chapters are listed next to the video in the portal.
trans-unit.source: The chapters are listed next to the video in the portal.
trans-unit.target: Los capítulos se muestran junto al vídeo en el portal.

trans-unit.resname: The end of the trimming must be after its start.
trans-unit.source: The end of the trimming must be after its start.
trans-unit.target: El fin del recorte debe ser posterior a su inicio.

trans-unit.resname: The end of a break must be after its start.
trans-unit.source: The end of a break must be after its start.
trans-unit.target: El fin de una pausa debe ser posterior a su inicio.

trans-unit.resname: Every break must be inside the trimming.
trans-unit.source: Every break must be inside the trimming.
trans-unit.target: Todas las pausas deben estar dentro del recorte.

trans-unit.resname: Breaks cannot be combined with a trimmed start: keep the start at 0 and add a break from the beginning instead.
trans-unit.source: Breaks cannot be combined with a trimmed start: keep the start at 0 and add a break from the beginning instead.
trans-unit.target: Las pausas no se pueden combinar con un recorte del inicio: deja el inicio en 0 y añade una pausa desde el principio.
